args.Description: "The mobile header was always visible because of hardcoded inline `display: flex` style overriding CSS media queries. Now we use `window.matchMedia` to only inject and show it on screens ≤768px, and clean up on resize."
args.Instruction: "Fix mobile header: hide on desktop, only show on mobile (<=768px). Remove hardcoded display:flex and paddingTop. Use media query check instead."
